anchors.symbol: String How long (in game ticks) it takes for a nucleeper to explode.
String The maximum explosion resistance that a block can have to be destroyed by a nuclear explosion. Set to zero to disable all nuclear explosion block breaking.
String Whether some block items are dropped by nuclear explosions. False if all destroyed blocks do not drop items.
String The scale of nuclear bomb destruction. multiply this by 16 to get the radius of a nuclear bomb explosion.
